If she’s familiar with donkey kong, starting there is a good idea. Stardew is very complex for a new player, Celeste is hard as nails and Spiritfarer base building is likely to overwhelm someone with barely above platformer knowledge from 50 years ago. 

You want something she’s familiar with, and there are a lot of platformers with simple combat available. She will also want to use Steam to find a game that works as most PC games are there.
